annotations.title: Find datasheets, manuals and other downloads

description: The downloads Trailhead Supply offers for a product model or a brand (manual, care_guide, size_chart, warranty), grouped by model, each file with its type, title, language, version, size and download link (open_url when a browser can show it inline). Narrow by query (a model number, a product's public_id or URL, or words of a title), by brand and by file type. A file hosted by its manufacturer is marked external.

limit.description: Most files in the answer (default and maximum 20).

locale.description: Answer language: en (default en). Names, labels and URLs follow it.

query.description: A model number, a product's public_id or page URL, or words of a document title.

name: find_documents

answer_type.description: What this answer is, for rendering.

external.description: True: the manufacturer hosts the file.

model.description: The model number, or the brand for files shared by many of its models.

product_url.description: The product page on the store's website, when the model is on sale.

more.description: More files than this answer holds: ask the next page or narrow the query.

truncated.description: Present and true only when the answer outgrew the size budget and its last list items were left out; ask narrower to see them.

title: Find datasheets, manuals and other downloads
